thread:
sasha: Heads-up — incoming internal API change that affects SDK routing headers. landing next week in the runtime; SDKs will need a small shim.
liam: can you paste the exact header change? need to check console telemetry and quota attribution implications.
sasha: sure — we'll stop supporting `X-Route-Policy: legacy` and replace it with `X-RD-Route: policy-v2`. fallback will be supported for 2 weeks, then 404 for unmatched policy.
maria: @sasha @liam ok — from DevEx side we need: 1) a clear migration snippet for py/ts/go, 2) a deprecation banner in the Console rollout UI, 3) a tiny FAQ for customers.
jonathan: quota mapping note — some customers currently map cost centers by the legacy header. when it flips they'll see mismatched attribution. we need the Console to show side-by-side "legacy vs v2 attribution" for the transition window.
liam: agree. plan: emit telemetry flag `route_policy_migration=true` for all requests from new SDKs so console can backfill. also add routing_version field to the per-request trace.
sasha: timeline: runtime change merges Fri EOD, rollout Mon. SDKs: patch releases Monday morning (py 3.2.0, ts 2.8.1, go 1.5.2). want DevEx banner and a Console tile that shows percent requests by routing_version by Wed.
maria: I'll draft the banner text and FAQ. need example snips though. can someone drop a tiny code example for each SDK?
liam: drop it — quick ones below. keep minimal and copyable.
liam: ```python
# python - simple header override
import requests
headers = {"X-RD-Route": "policy-v2", "X-RD-Client-Version": "redwood-py/3.2.0"}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", json={"prompt":"hi"}, headers=headers)
```
liam: ```ts
// ts/ft - fetch example
fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'X-RD-Route': 'policy-v2', 'X-RD-Client-Version': 'redwood-ts/2.8.1' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hi' })
})
```
liam: ```go
// go - http client
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(jsonBody))
req.Header.Set("X-RD-Route", "policy-v2")
req.Header.Set("X-RD-Client-Version", "redwood-go/1.5.2")
```
maria: perfect. i'll add those to the migration guide. question: do SDKs need an automatic shim so older code continues to work without user changes?
sasha: runtime will accept legacy header for 2 weeks, but we want SDKs to opt into sending v2. plan: ship a toggle in SDKs ON by default for new versions, but add `RD_ROUTE_LEGACY_FALLBACK=true` env var for customers who want to delay.
jonathan: must ensure quota pipelines don't dedupe incorrectly when both headers are sent. telemetry should prefer `X-RD-Route` if present. please add note in rollout runbook.
liam: noted. also adding a small telemetry metric `sdk_route_header_mismatch` to catch clients sending both.
eva: CI: build redwood-py/3.2.0 succeeded on main — artifacts at https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/py/3.2.0
maria: one more ask — DevEx wants console to show "affected customers" list based on SDK version in last 7d. can eng-platform expose that via the internal API? we can then send an email to customers.
liam: yes — internal API `GET /internal/clients?since=7d&field=client_version` will be extended. adding a `routing_version` column to the query results.
sasha: ok owners: eng-platform (liam) adds API + metric; runtime (sasha) flips header support and ensures fallback; SDKs (liam + contributors) patch releases; devex (maria) migrations, banner, FAQ and customer comms.
maria: i'll draft the banner copy and a short snippet for the Console rollout tile. posting first pass shortly.
jonathan: i'll update the quota runbook and add the dedupe rule.
liam: if anyone sees edgecases (multi-tenant proxies, internal proxies rewriting headers) please shout now.
sasha: thanks all — tight window but doable. follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
